title: Hume Center funded by former CIA S&T officer Ted Hume

tellings.quote: to tell you the Hume Center was funded by science and technology guy from CIA named Ted Hugh and his wife Ted was left CIA started a company did well sold it to kinetic and plowed some of the money back into the center

plain: The Hume Center, a research center at Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, Virginia, was paid for by a former CIA science and technology officer named Ted Hume and his wife. That is what Bob McGwier, a guest who speaks from his own knowledge of the center, tells Michels: Hume left the CIA, started a company that did well, sold it to a firm McGwier calls Kinetic, and put some of the money back into the center. If so, the center has a direct money tie to a former CIA man.
